name: CONSTRAINTS
observations: uiReliability: Function of UI structure (deterministic targets, clear feedback), not AI capability. Permanent constraint.
pathDepth: src/features/{feat}/{page}/ â†’ ../../../ root (exactly 3 levels)
pythonVersion: Target <=3.12. 3.13 wheels not in ecosystem.
imagePolicy: NEVER embed base64 in prompts or files.
windowFocus: Use Win32 SetForegroundWindow, NOT pygetwindow (unreliable)
responseTimeout: 60s complex reasoning (30s is too short)
dataSchema: activities.js enforces {userId, contentId, type, metadata, ts}
deploymentFlow: git push â†’ GitHub Actions â†’ Firebase Hosting (1-2min CDN propagate)

name: FAILURE_OVERFLOW_230K
observations: Symptom: Context overflow token error
Root cause: Embedded base64 image in ai_output.json
Severity: CRITICAL
Fix: Remove all base64 from signal files. Use binary transport or file refs.

name: FAILURE_IMPORT_MIME
observations: Symptom: MIME type error, module not found
Root cause: Path depth calculation wrong (counted 2 levels instead of 3)
Severity: HIGH
Fix: From src/features/X/Y/ = ../../../ always. Verify via (depth+page_depth+1).

name: FAILURE_PY_WHEELS
observations: Symptom: pip install fails: pre-built wheels don't exist
Root cause: Python 3.13 too new; wheel builders haven't caught up
Severity: BLOCKING
Fix: Use Python 3.12 or earlier. No manual override.

name: FAILURE_AI_LOOP
observations: Symptom: AI repeats same command 5 times, doesn't see changed state
Root cause: No feedback in state JSON; screenshot unchanged between turns
Severity: MEDIUM
Fix: Add state.recent_actions + state.action_feedback fields. Include execution results.

name: FAILURE_AUTOMATION_CHAOS
observations: Symptom: Automation fails on news feed, social media, chat UIs
Root cause: Excessive target ambiguity; AI reasoning loop explodes (10K+ tokens)
Severity: DESIGN
Fix: Don't automate chaotic UIs. Whitelist forms, spreadsheets, terminals only.

name: FAILURE_WINDOW_FOCUS
observations: Symptom: Target window doesn't come to foreground; focus stays on calling app
Root cause: Using pygetwindow.activate() which fails on Windows minimized windows
Severity: OPERATIONAL
Fix: Use Win32 API: ctypes.windll.user32.SetForegroundWindow(hwnd)

name: DESIGN_PRINCIPLES
observations: transparency: Report reliability as honestly as capability. User can make informed decision.
layering: Free stuff first (detection), paid stuff last (AI vision). Order by cost.
immutability: State files are audit trail. Keep for debugging, don't mutate.
extensibility: Bridge pattern + config = add provider without code change.
graceful: Fail safely: refuse low-confidence action, not guess.
compression: Denormalize write, query read. Fast reads beat slow writes at scale.
